name: cortico-world-coo-draw
description: Cortico World: one drawing studio with two tabs — the persona's small hand-drawn pictures through the Qianwen API, and the user's own ComfyUI pictures. Each persona-facing call site can choose its backend; diary drawings keep the persona's hand.

zh.description: 一个插件装两种画法：API 绘画让桌宠按自己的人设画 512×512 的小画（画夹、评价、额度），本地出图借你的 ComfyUI 出你自己的图（模型、LoRA、工作流、历史）。桌宠主动画和日记配图可以各自选 API 或本地，日记里的画仍保持铃兰的手笔。

en.description: Two ways to draw in one plugin: persona-styled API drawings (gallery, ratings, quota) and your own local ComfyUI pictures (checkpoints, LoRAs, workflows, history). Pet drawings and diary illustrations can each pick a backend, and diary pictures keep the persona's hand.
